extraction: Adversarial Review SKILL.md protocol for SWE-bench Verified. The paper includes AR's SKILL.md embedded between BEGIN VERBATIM SKILL CONTENT and END VERBATIM SKILL CONTENT markers. It instantiates the abstract two-phase workflow from AR's SKILL.md as a concrete SWE-bench routine, including the plan-artifact location (APPROACH.md) and how the inner/outer loops map to the Plan review and Code review phases. AR-specific; MARS has its own concrete workflow embedded in its SKILL.md body. SWE-bench Verified result important: AR still improves performance when expressed only as a SKILL.md protocol, without a Python orchestrator forcing every step. This demonstrates the protocol can be followed by autonomous coding agents without external enforcement.
